title: Strange clues in last night's dream
content: At first, I was in a classroom setting learning about certain stuff. In my mind, I was thinking how did I end up being in school if I was supposed to be getting for work. Anyways, I transported back to the astral version of my house and then I noticed that something didn't feel right. I walked to the backyard and then walked to an area of the backyard until I saw a strange replica of the Earth globe in the sky complete with high rise buildings in certain places. I started to concentrate in order to be able to go there and then somehow all of the stars besides that Earth replica (including the replica) began to be swallowed by a strange worm hole. Then I was transported back to where I was sleeping and then I went to the backyard once again looking for answers. Anyways this time, the stars somehow beamed me a guy named "John Lewis Carroll". Ofc it was a hologram, but I thought it was strange that it had a name similar to the Lewis Carroll author who has written the "Into the Looking Glass" Book. Then several minutes later I woke up for real. I went to the backyard and strangely enough the Moon was in the same spot where the wormhole showed up in my dream. Theory time: Is the Moon somehow blocking a wormhole out of the view from the masses? Is that wormhole actually the gateway to real freedom or is it the thing that is powering this matrix we are in this whole time? Is the Moon somehow a major component of Project Looking Glass? So many questions to think about. Somehow I felt that my dreams gave me scattered clues here and there. But for the time being, thats all I was able to get from my dream.
